identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a vibrant, student-friendly mentorship platform that bridges the gap between alumni and students with electric optimism.

headings.usage: Use for all section headers, hero titles, and card titles. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraph text, inputs, and UI elements. Relaxed leading.

mono.usage: Use for code snippets, API keys, or technical data displays.

primary.description: Vibrant Electric Purple. Use for primary buttons, active states, and key brand elements.

secondary.description: Pale Lavender. Use for secondary buttons, backgrounds of active items, and subtle highlights.

accent.description: Vibrant Coral/Orange. Use for CTAs that need to pop against the purple.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays on solid color backgrounds to add depth.

marketing.hero_style: Split screen with 3D element or 'Tetris' grid of images.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar Navigation + Top Header + Main Content Area

buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80

students.description: Group of students collaborating with laptop

general: Use the 'Electric Optimism' theme: Light mode with vibrant purple/indigo primary and coral accents.
Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for marketing pages and 'Control Room Grid' for dashboards.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states and transitions.
Use 'sonner' for toasts and 'lucide-react' for icons.
Do not use gradients for text, only for backgrounds or accents.
dashboard_specific: Use a sidebar layout for the dashboard.
Use cards with 'shadow-card' and 'rounded-xl' for widgets.
Ensure high contrast for data visualization.
Use 'recharts' for any charts or graphs.
marketing_specific: Use large, bold typography for hero sections.
Use the provided images in a 'bento' or 'tetris' layout.

universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold with spacing and typography.
